bio_en: Wansong Xingxiu was a Caodong Chan teacher active under the Jin and early Mongol regimes. He studied with Xueyan Huiman and taught at monasteries in northern China. His commentary on Hongzhi Zhengjue's one hundred verse cases forms the Book of Serenity.
bio_summary: 行秀號萬松，嗣雪巖慧滿，弘曹洞宗旨。評唱宏智頌古百則為《從容庵錄》，兼通諸家而以洞上為本。
